# PointLight

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/logic/components/point_light.h`](../../../src/logic/components/point_light.h) · Scene / prefab name: `PointLight` · Described in `data/core.json`

A torch or fire next to a Transform; the nearest light the scene

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `color` | `glm::vec3` | (1, 0.62, 0.3) |
| `intensity` | `float` | light on a surface facing it one metre away (12) |
| `radius` | `float` | metres, nothing lit beyond (18), must be positive |

## Notes

Gathered into the renderer's Lights each frame.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: Lights, ProbeVolume. Written by: DebugMenu, Torch. Created by: DebugMenu, Torch. Destroyed by: DebugMenu, Torch.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [DebugMenu](../systems/DebugMenu.md) | system | Host | **readwrite+create+destroy** | tick | counted; "Torch here" makes one 1.5 m ahead of the camera; "No torches" destroys every entity with one |
| [Torch](../systems/Torch.md) | system | Host | **write+create** | init | colour, intensity and radius from the params |
| [Torch](../systems/Torch.md) | system | Host | **destroy** | finish | with its entity |
| [Lights](../systems/service-Lights.md) | service | Host | **read** | update | Torches: colour, intensity, radius. |
| [ProbeVolume](../systems/service-ProbeVolume.md) | service | Host | **read** | update | Torches: probes within their radius are traced every frame. |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[DebugMenu](../systems/DebugMenu.md)**
  - One ImGui window "Dynamical" (needs UI before it).
  - Changing the soil or grass height-map parameters makes SoilMaps / GrassPass bake their per-chunk maps again (they watch RenderSettings).
  - Creates torch entities and dynamic boxes (Jolt bodies through RigidBodySys) on button presses; destroys every PointLight entity on "No torches".
- **[Lights](../systems/service-Lights.md)**
  - Writes the mapped lights uniform buffer of the frame and sets Context::lights_buffers.
- **[ProbeVolume](../systems/service-ProbeVolume.md)**
  - Allocates pages of 3D probe textures (61 MB each, logged), uploads the brick table and the probe classes.
  - Records the probe dispatches into the frame's compute command buffer.
  - Writes the Context probe pointers read by every view set; waits for the device when its buffer grows.
- **[Torch](../systems/Torch.md)**
  - Creates one entity in init and destroys it in finish.
